TryModifyRestSiteOptions.rationale: `options.Add(new HatchRestSiteOption(player))` (ByrdonisEgg.cs:25) == `options.append(RestSiteOption('HATCH', lambda run: run.add_relic('byrdpip')))`. The deck-card rest-site hook exists in the sim (`Card.modify_rest_site_options`, cards/base.py:306-308) and `RunState.rest_site_options()` scans the deck BEFORE the relics, matching IterateHookListeners's order. C# returns a bool (true when it added an option) that the sim's None-returning signature drops; that value only tells the caller whether any listener contributed, and no ported caller branches on it.

ctor.issue: QUEST / QUEST / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every local and global cost modifier and keeps reporting -1; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain in `Card.energy_cost` (cards/base.py:222-232). `GetAmountToSpend()` clamps to Math.Max(0, ...) (CardEnergyCost.cs:134-139), so the two agree on what is SPENT -- only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's and card/bad_luck's ctor entries (rule 3). DORMANT: the three ported cost readers agree today -- relics/mummified_hand.py:25 and potions.py:168 filter `> 0`, cards/event_cards.py:328 (Enlightenment) skips `<= 1` -- and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses, statuses or quests. Live as soon as any effect reads an unplayable card's cost without a `> 0` filter.

OnPlay.rationale: ByrdonisEgg.cs declares no OnPlay and the card is Unplayable; the sim's abstract method is a `pass`.

guards.what: the sim adds `can_be_generated_by_modifiers = False` (event_cards.py:40), which ByrdonisEgg.cs does NOT override
guards.rationale: C# leaves `CanBeGeneratedByModifiers` at its `=> true` default (CardModel.cs:648). The flag only filters the RANDOM CURSE pool (cards/base.py:88-91 -- the CursedRun modifier, Neow's Bones, Sere Talon), and a Quest card of Quest rarity is not in that pool on either side, so the extra False is unreachable and changes nothing. Recorded because it is an unsourced attribute, not because it diverges.
Multiplayer-only ownership gate; the sim is single-player and its hook receives the run directly.
